## Seedream V5.5 API

Seedream V5.5 is an image generation and image editing model by ByteDance Seed, available on the Venice API as `seedream-v5-5`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Seedream V5.5 is ByteDance Seed's Seedream 5.5, generating high-quality images at 1K, 1.5K, or 2K with improved realism and text rendering. It pairs with Seedream V5.5 Edit.

### Seedream V5.5 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seedream-v5-5` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.03 / image |
| `seedream-v5-5-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.03 / edit |

### Seedream V5.5 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ByteDance Seed |
| Released | Nov 10, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 1.5K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:3 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Seedream V5.5 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "seedream-v5-5"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "seedream-v5-5",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
